# Original third-party notice records

Version-specific original texts remain in the package directories. Package metadata and partial notices do not establish complete license compliance.

## Original bundled Fontkit notices

[@pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 embedded notices](packages/@pdf-lib/fontkit/1.1.1/embedded-notices.md) preserve exact original ES/UMD comment bodies, including Google Apache-2.0 headers, base64-arraybuffer notices and the Joyent/Node MIT comment. Their exact archive and byte-position relationships are indexed. These component notices do not establish the missing original root copyright/permission notice or complete bundled dependency/source-offer closure.
